content.title: Report a Minor Traffic Crash
content.summary: To report a minor traffic crash in Arvada, citizens must use the Colorado State Patrol's online system within 30 days, as the Arvada Police Department does not accept walk-in crash reports. This reporting method is applicable in specific situations, such as during an Accident Alert or for hit-and-run incidents on private property.
content.body:
Do you need to report a minor traffic crash in Arvada? You can do so using the Colorado State Patrol's online system. The Arvada Police Department does not take over-the-counter crash reports on a walk-in basis. Citizens involved in a minor crash in the City of Arvada should visit [Colorado State Patrol Site](https://www.colorado.gov/pacific/csp/crash-information) within 30 days to file a crash report.

**Use the CSP Website:**

- if an Accident Alert was in effect at the time the crash occurred;
- if a hit and run accident occurs on private property and there is no suspect information;
- if drivers have exchanged information and left the scene; or,
- if minor crash occurred on private property.

Visit the [Colorado State Patrol Site](https://www.colorado.gov/pacific/csp/crash-information).
